frames.heading: Player
frames.body: Well, that wasn't part of the plan. You okay, Mojo?

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: I think so... but something feels off. My mojo... it's like it's gone.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: What do you mean gone? You're the funkiest being in the galaxy! Maybe it’s just the crash shock.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: No, this is different. I can't feel the rhythm, the groove... it's like I've been unplugged from the funk.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: That hum... do you hear it? It’s everywhere. It's messing with our systems.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: The sound waves... they’re blocking my mojo power.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: So, what do we do now? We can’t stay here forever, and we sure can’t perform with our tech busted.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: We fix the ship, get my mojo back, and find out what's really going on here. But first, we need to explore this place. There’s gotta be someone who can help us out.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: Guess I’ll have to take your place on stage for now. I might not have your groove, but I can still hold a beat.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: You’ve got heart, Player. That’s what counts. Let's get to it then!

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: Alright, let’s go. And Mojo, we’re getting your mojo back, no matter what!!
